txn.get.title: gocbcore fetchDocWithMeta() — a transaction's read, its doc's body and its "txn" xattr together

atr.confirm.title: gocbcore confirmATRPending() — before the first write, choose the ATR, and mark the attempt PENDING

atr.select.title: gocbcore selectAtrLocked() — the ATR for the vbucket of the first doc changed

atr.pending.title: gocbcore setATRPendingLocked() — the attempt's entry, in the ATR's "attempts" xattr
atr.pending.code:
atrFieldOp("tst", "${Mutation.CAS}", memd.SubdocFlagXattrPath|memd.SubdocFlagExpandMacros),
				atrFieldOp("tid", t.transactionID, memd.SubdocFlagXattrPath),
				atrFieldOp("st", jsonAtrStatePending, memd.SubdocFlagXattrPath),
				atrFieldOp("exp", time.Until(t.expiryTime)/time.Millisecond, memd.SubdocFlagXattrPath),
				{
					Op:    memd.SubDocOpSetDoc,
					Flags: memd.SubdocFlagNone,
					Path:  "",
					Value: []byte{0},
				},

stage.replace.title: gocbcore stageReplace() — the new value, staged in the doc's "txn" xattr; its body untouched

atr.commit.title: gocbcore setATRCommittedLocked() — one write to one doc, COMMITTED and the docs it covers
atr.commit.code:
atrFieldOp("st", jsonAtrStateCommitted, memd.SubdocFlagXattrPath, memd.SubDocOpDictSet),
				atrFieldOp("tsc", "${Mutation.CAS}", memd.SubdocFlagXattrPath|memd.SubdocFlagExpandMacros, memd.SubDocOpDictSet),
				atrFieldOp("p", 0, memd.SubdocFlagXattrPath, memd.SubDocOpDictAdd),
				atrFieldOp("ins", insMutations, memd.SubdocFlagXattrPath, memd.SubDocOpDictSet),
				atrFieldOp("rep", repMutations, memd.SubdocFlagXattrPath, memd.SubDocOpDictSet),
				atrFieldOp("rem", remMutations, memd.SubdocFlagXattrPath, memd.SubDocOpDictSet),

unstage.title: gocbcore commitStagedReplace() — the staged value becomes the body, and the "txn" xattr goes

atr.complete.title: gocbcore setATRCompletedLocked() — the attempt's entry, deleted from the ATR
